from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,plistlib,re,subprocess,tempfile
image=Path('/private/tmp/logex-audit-130-cross-device-gpwks2ai/exfat.dmg');mount=image.parent/'exfat';binary=Path('/tmp/logex-current-live-profile-tests');out=Path('/tmp/logex-current-live-profile.jsonl')
def attached():
 records=plistlib.loads(subprocess.check_output(['hdiutil','info','-plist']))
 matches=[r for r in records.get('images',[]) if Path(r['image-path']).resolve()==image.resolve()];assert len(matches)<=1
 return matches[0] if matches else None
assert image.is_file() and not image.is_symlink() and binary.is_file() and attached() is None
with out.open('w') as output:
 output.write(json.dumps({'kind':'environment','commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'diagnostic_only':True,'source_diff':Path('/tmp/logex-current-live-profile.diff').read_text(),'builder_source':Path('/tmp/logex-current-live-profile-build.py').read_text(),'runner_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'hardware':subprocess.check_output(['sysctl','-n','hw.model','hw.memsize','hw.ncpu'],text=True),'rustc':subprocess.check_output(['rustc','-Vv'],text=True),'os':subprocess.check_output(['sw_vers'],text=True),'limitation':'Instrumented release unit-test build; nested scope times overlap and include instrumentation costs. Not a performance acceptance comparison. All temporary instrumented source restored before execution; complete v3 row/progress/clean-reopen oracles retained. Three 128-block per-block-publication live runs on each filesystem. Disposable image on internal APFS; not the protected USB volume.'})+'\n');output.flush()
 def run(filesystem,parent):
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='logex-live-profile-',dir=parent) as temp:
   env={**os.environ,'TMPDIR':temp,'LOGEX_PUBLICATION_ROUTE':'live','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_BLOCKS':'128','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_ROWS_PER_BLOCK':'128','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_WARM_HEADERS':'8192','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_HISTORY_BLOCKS':'2048','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_SEGMENT_ROWS':'1000000','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_REPEATS':'3','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_HEADER_FIELDS':'minimal','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_CHECKPOINT_EACH_BLOCK':'1','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_DURABLE_CHECKPOINT':'0'}
   logfile=Path('/tmp/logex-current-live-profile-'+filesystem+'.log');print('Profiling',filesystem,flush=True)
   with logfile.open('w') as log:r=subprocess.run([str(binary),'audit_live_profile::benchmark_sync_storage_publication','--ignored','--nocapture','--test-threads=1'],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
   if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(str(logfile))
   for line in logfile.read_text().splitlines():
    if '{' not in line:continue
    try:record=json.loads(line[line.index('{'):])
    except json.JSONDecodeError:continue
    output.write(json.dumps({**record,'filesystem':filesystem})+'\n')
    if record.get('kind')=='phase_profile':print(filesystem,record,flush=True)
   output.flush()
 run('apfs','/private/tmp')
 assert mount.is_dir() and not mount.is_symlink() and os.stat(mount).st_dev==os.stat(image.parent).st_dev
 subprocess.check_call(['hdiutil','attach',str(image),'-mountpoint',str(mount),'-nobrowse'])
 try:
  selected=attached();assert selected is not None and any(x.get('mount-point')==str(mount)for x in selected['system-entities'])
  volume=plistlib.loads(subprocess.check_output(['diskutil','info','-plist',str(mount)]));assert volume['FilesystemType']=='exfat'
  run('exfat',mount)
 finally:
  selected=attached()
  if selected is not None:
   assert any(x.get('mount-point')==str(mount)for x in selected['system-entities'])
   devices=[x['dev-entry']for x in selected['system-entities']if re.fullmatch(r'/dev/disk[0-9]+',x.get('dev-entry',''))];assert len(devices)==1
   subprocess.check_call(['hdiutil','detach',devices[0]])
  assert attached() is None
  print('Disposable image detached',flush=True)
